a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Person Behind the Hit
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: An interviewer asks whether success has changed how you treat the people who knew you before the music. Your manager signals that the segment is live.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Thank the people who supported me
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When an interviewer asked how fame had changed me, I chose to thank the people who supported me.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When an interviewer asked how fame had changed me, I chose to admit I am still learning.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Turn the answer into an album plug
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When an interviewer asked how fame had changed me, I chose to turn the answer into an album plug.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When an interviewer asked how fame had changed me, I chose to mock the question.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Uncomfortable Question
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A presenter reads an old post of yours that fans find dismissive. You remember writing it in frustration, but the clip leaves out the context.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: During an interview about an old post, I chose to explain the context and apologize.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Listen to why fans were hurt
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: During an interview about an old post, I chose to listen to why fans were hurt.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: During an interview about an old post, I chose to blame the presenter.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: During an interview about an old post, I chose to refuse to discuss it.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: Who Wrote the Hook?
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A host praises the hook in your music as if you wrote every part alone. A collaborator is watching the broadcast and has already messaged you.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a host overlooked a collaborator, I chose to give my collaborator credit.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a host overlooked a collaborator, I chose to describe how we worked together.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a host overlooked a collaborator, I chose to accept all the praise.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a host overlooked a collaborator, I chose to change the subject.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: Rival on the Sofa
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: You arrive for a relaxed interview and discover the other guest is an artist whose fans have been arguing with yours. The host asks who deserves the bigger career.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: During a joint interview with a rival, I chose to praise our different strengths.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: During a joint interview with a rival, I chose to suggest a friendly collaboration.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Make a playful joke about the rivalry
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: During a joint interview with a rival, I chose to make a playful joke about the rivalry.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: During a joint interview with a rival, I chose to insult the other artist.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Quiet Comeback
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: An interviewer asks why you stepped away from the spotlight. You are comfortable sharing some of your story, but not every private detail.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Share what I am comfortable sharing
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: At a comeback interview, I chose to share what I am comfortable sharing.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: At a comeback interview, I chose to set a polite boundary.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Discuss what I learned while away
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: At a comeback interview, I chose to discuss what I learned while away.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: At a comeback interview, I chose to invent a dramatic explanation.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: A Fan Gets the Microphone
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A fan in the studio audience asks why your latest creative direction sounds different. They miss the older music but seem willing to listen.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a fan questioned my creative direction, I chose to explain what inspired the change.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Thank them for sticking with me
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a fan questioned my creative direction, I chose to thank them for sticking with me.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a fan questioned my creative direction, I chose to promise never to change again.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a fan questioned my creative direction, I chose to tell them to stop listening.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: Off the Record?
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: After a radio interview ends, the host asks for gossip about another artist. A recording light remains on behind the desk.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a host asked for gossip after an interview, I chose to keep the conversation respectful.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Ask whether we are still recording
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a host asked for gossip after an interview, I chose to ask whether we are still recording.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a host asked for gossip after an interview, I chose to offer a harmless studio anecdote.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a host asked for gossip after an interview, I chose to share a cruel rumor.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: Your Own Questions
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A youth radio station invites you to choose the subject of an interview. They can focus on the music, the business, or a headline about your personal life.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a youth station let me shape an interview, I chose to discuss how I make music.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a youth station let me shape an interview, I chose to explain what beginners should know.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Talk about the pressure of fame
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a youth station let me shape an interview, I chose to talk about the pressure of fame.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Use the time to attack critics
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a youth station let me shape an interview, I chose to use the time to attack critics.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Safer Single
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: Your label wants a familiar sounding single. You prefer a riskier direction, and both sides have strong opinions about what listeners will enjoy.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: During a disagreement over a single, I chose to explain my creative vision.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: During a disagreement over a single, I chose to suggest testing both versions.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: During a disagreement over a single, I chose to accept the label suggestion.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: During a disagreement over a single, I chose to humiliate the team in public.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: Credits Before Clout
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A draft of your release announcement leaves a session musician out of the credits. The label says correcting it will delay the announcement.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a session musician was left out of the credits, I chose to correct the credits first.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a session musician was left out of the credits, I chose to contact the musician personally.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Publish now and correct it later
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a session musician was left out of the credits, I chose to publish now and correct it later.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a session musician was left out of the credits, I chose to pretend I never noticed.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Viral Shortcut
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A marketing executive suggests turning a private argument into a promotional clip. It would attract attention, but the other person never agreed to be part of the campaign.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When my team proposed using a private argument for promotion, I chose to reject the idea.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When my team proposed using a private argument for promotion, I chose to offer a staged fictional alternative.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Ask the other person for permission
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When my team proposed using a private argument for promotion, I chose to ask the other person for permission.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When my team proposed using a private argument for promotion, I chose to upload the private clip.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: Surprise Release Pressure
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: Your team wants to announce a surprise release tonight. You like the excitement, but a key piece of the creative work still needs attention.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Finish the work before announcing it
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When my team pushed for a surprise announcement, I chose to finish the work before announcing it.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When my team pushed for a surprise announcement, I chose to announce a realistic teaser date.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Release an honest work in progress
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When my team pushed for a surprise announcement, I chose to release an honest work in progress.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When my team pushed for a surprise announcement, I chose to claim everything is finished.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Image Meeting
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: Your label presents a new public image that looks nothing like you. They call it a reinvention; you worry it will make every interview feel like acting.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Build the image around my own style
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: At a meeting about my public image, I chose to build the image around my own style.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Try a few ideas without promising anything
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: At a meeting about my public image, I chose to try a few ideas without promising anything.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: At a meeting about my public image, I chose to ask trusted fans for feedback.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Adopt an image I openly dislike
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: At a meeting about my public image, I chose to adopt an image I openly dislike.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: A Sponsor With Strings
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A sponsor likes your music but wants you to avoid discussing a cause you care about. The offer would also give your team a bigger promotional platform.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a sponsor tried to limit what I could discuss, I chose to keep my principles.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a sponsor tried to limit what I could discuss, I chose to negotiate clear boundaries.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a sponsor tried to limit what I could discuss, I chose to decline without making a scene.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a sponsor tried to limit what I could discuss, I chose to attack everyone involved online.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Leaked Demo
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: An unfinished demo appears online. Some fans love the raw version, while others mistake its rough mix for your finished work.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: After an unfinished demo leaked, I chose to explain that it is unfinished.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Thank listeners and show the creative process
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: After an unfinished demo leaked, I chose to thank listeners and show the creative process.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: After an unfinished demo leaked, I chose to let the mystery build.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: After an unfinished demo leaked, I chose to blame an innocent collaborator.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: Promises on a Poster
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A draft promotional poster calls your next project a guaranteed classic. Your team thinks the claim is bold; you think it puts words in the listeners mouths.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Let the music speak for itself
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a poster promised too much about my project, I chose to let the music speak for itself.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Use a line about the inspiration instead
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a poster promised too much about my project, I chose to use a line about the inspiration instead.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Keep the boast as a playful slogan
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a poster promised too much about my project, I chose to keep the boast as a playful slogan.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a poster promised too much about my project, I chose to promise awards before the release.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Next Chapter
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: Fans want to know whether your next project continues your familiar sound or starts a new chapter. You have enough ideas for either direction.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Blend familiar sounds with new ideas
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When fans asked about my next creative chapter, I chose to blend familiar sounds with new ideas.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When fans asked about my next creative chapter, I chose to explain the new direction honestly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Celebrate the sound that brought me here
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When fans asked about my next creative chapter, I chose to celebrate the sound that brought me here.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Say the old fans do not matter
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When fans asked about my next creative chapter, I chose to say the old fans do not matter.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Listening Room
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: At a small preview session, one listener politely says the most personal moment on your project feels unfinished. Everyone watches to see how you respond.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: At a preview listening session, I chose to ask what did not connect.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: At a preview listening session, I chose to explain the intention and listen.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: At a preview listening session, I chose to try a different arrangement.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Remove the listener from the room
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: At a preview listening session, I chose to remove the listener from the room.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: Deluxe or Distraction?
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: Your team proposes a deluxe edition. You can share meaningful extra material, but you also worry that adding everything will distract from the original project.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: During a discussion about a deluxe edition, I chose to choose only the strongest extras.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Share creative notes alongside the music
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: During a discussion about a deluxe edition, I chose to share creative notes alongside the music.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: During a discussion about a deluxe edition, I chose to keep the original project complete.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Market unfinished scraps as essential tracks
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: During a discussion about a deluxe edition, I chose to market unfinished scraps as essential tracks.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: A Visual Thread
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: Your creative team pitches a visual theme connecting the release artwork and performances. One concept is striking but has nothing to do with the music.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Choose the theme that fits the songs
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When my creative team pitched a visual theme, I chose to choose the theme that fits the songs.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When my creative team pitched a visual theme, I chose to develop a new concept together.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Try the striking concept as an experiment
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When my creative team pitched a visual theme, I chose to try the striking concept as an experiment.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Copy another artist entire visual identity
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When my creative team pitched a visual theme, I chose to copy another artist entire visual identity.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Missing Verse
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A collaborator asks why an important verse was removed from a preview version. You had creative reasons, but forgot to explain them before the listening session.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a collaborator questioned a missing verse, I chose to discuss the decision privately.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a collaborator questioned a missing verse, I chose to listen to their revised version.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a collaborator questioned a missing verse, I chose to apologize for the poor communication.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a collaborator questioned a missing verse, I chose to make fun of their writing.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Anniversary Edition
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A fan group wants you to revisit an older project for its anniversary. You are proud of it, though some choices no longer represent your present taste.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Discuss what the project meant then
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When fans asked me to revisit an older project, I chose to discuss what the project meant then.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When fans asked me to revisit an older project, I chose to share a fresh interpretation.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Celebrate it without rewriting its history
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When fans asked me to revisit an older project, I chose to celebrate it without rewriting its history.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Call the people who love it outdated
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When fans asked me to revisit an older project, I chose to call the people who love it outdated.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: Two Worlds, One Sound
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: An artist from a different genre proposes a collaboration. Your teams worry about confusing listeners, but the creative chemistry feels promising.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When an artist from another genre proposed a collaboration, I chose to explore the shared creative ideas.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Start with a small studio experiment
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When an artist from another genre proposed a collaboration, I chose to start with a small studio experiment.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When an artist from another genre proposed a collaboration, I chose to explain the crossover to fans.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When an artist from another genre proposed a collaboration, I chose to dismiss their whole genre.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Honest Liner Notes
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: Your team asks how much personal context to include in the project notes. Some stories involve people who have never chosen a public life.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: While planning the project notes, I chose to focus on my own experiences.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: While planning the project notes, I chose to ask permission before naming people.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Keep the notes about the craft
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: While planning the project notes, I chose to keep the notes about the craft.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Reveal someone private story for attention
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: While planning the project notes, I chose to reveal someone private story for attention.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: Two Fandoms Collide
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A disagreement between fan communities turns into a flood of hostile comments. Both sides claim they are defending their favorite artist.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Ask my fans to keep it respectful
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When two fan communities began attacking each other, I chose to ask my fans to keep it respectful.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When two fan communities began attacking each other, I chose to celebrate both artists work.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When two fan communities began attacking each other, I chose to stay out of the argument.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When two fan communities began attacking each other, I chose to encourage the harassment.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Shared Release Date
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: Another artist announces a release on the same date as yours. A blogger frames it as a feud even though neither artist has said anything hostile.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a blogger turned a release date into a feud, I chose to wish the other artist well.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Explain that listeners can enjoy both
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a blogger turned a release date into a feud, I chose to explain that listeners can enjoy both.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a blogger turned a release date into a feud, I chose to make a friendly chart prediction.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a blogger turned a release date into a feud, I chose to accuse them of sabotaging me.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: A Misquoted Lyric
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A fan account claims a line in your music insults another artist. The interpretation is spreading faster than the context.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Explain the meaning without naming names
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a lyric was misinterpreted as an insult, I chose to explain the meaning without naming names.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a lyric was misinterpreted as an insult, I chose to contact the other artist privately.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a lyric was misinterpreted as an insult, I chose to let listeners interpret it freely.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Invent a feud to promote the song
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a lyric was misinterpreted as an insult, I chose to invent a feud to promote the song.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Invitation
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: An artist you have disagreed with invites you to a charity performance. Your team expects fans to treat every photo as evidence of a secret feud or friendship.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a rival invited me to a charity performance, I chose to focus on the cause.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a rival invited me to a charity performance, I chose to accept and keep it professional.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a rival invited me to a charity performance, I chose to decline politely.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a rival invited me to a charity performance, I chose to publicly mock the invitation.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Fan Moderator
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A volunteer moderator tells you your fan community is becoming exhausting to manage. They love the music but are tired of settling arguments every day.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Thank them and encourage a break
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a fan moderator said they felt overwhelmed, I chose to thank them and encourage a break.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a fan moderator said they felt overwhelmed, I chose to support clearer community rules.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a fan moderator said they felt overwhelmed, I chose to listen without making promises.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a fan moderator said they felt overwhelmed, I chose to demand that they work harder.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Fan Edit
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A fan makes a thoughtful video connecting your older music with your newer work. A team member suggests reposting it without mentioning who made it.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Credit the creator when sharing it
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a fan made a thoughtful video about my work, I chose to credit the creator when sharing it.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Ask the creator before reposting it
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a fan made a thoughtful video about my work, I chose to ask the creator before reposting it.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a fan made a thoughtful video about my work, I chose to leave them a kind comment.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Present the edit as my team work
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a fan made a thoughtful video about my work, I chose to present the edit as my team work.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: A Rival Gives Credit
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: An artist whose fans compete with yours says your work inspired them. A presenter asks whether you believe the compliment is sincere.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a rival said my work inspired them, I chose to accept the compliment graciously.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Share what I admire about their work
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a rival said my work inspired them, I chose to share what I admire about their work.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Say I appreciate it without speculating
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a rival said my work inspired them, I chose to say I appreciate it without speculating.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a rival said my work inspired them, I chose to accuse them of chasing attention.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Chart Screenshot
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A screenshot appears to show your music ahead of a rival, but the dates do not match. Fans ask you to repost it as proof that you won.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When fans sent me a misleading chart screenshot, I chose to check the dates before sharing.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When fans sent me a misleading chart screenshot, I chose to thank fans without comparing artists.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Explain why the comparison is misleading
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When fans sent me a misleading chart screenshot, I chose to explain why the comparison is misleading.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Post it with a victory caption
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When fans sent me a misleading chart screenshot, I chose to post it with a victory caption.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: Back in the Room
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: You return to a studio where you once had a disappointing session. The team asks whether you want to revisit the old idea or start fresh.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When I returned to a studio after a disappointing session, I chose to build on what I learned.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When I returned to a studio after a disappointing session, I chose to start fresh with clear expectations.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When I returned to a studio after a disappointing session, I chose to discuss the unfinished idea together.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Blame everyone for the old session
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When I returned to a studio after a disappointing session, I chose to blame everyone for the old session.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Second Chance Clip
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A short rehearsal clip earns warm comments after a stretch of criticism. Your team wants to turn the moment into a declaration that every critic was wrong.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a rehearsal clip received a warm response, I chose to thank people for listening again.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Let the progress speak for itself
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a rehearsal clip received a warm response, I chose to let the progress speak for itself.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Share what improved in my preparation
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a rehearsal clip received a warm response, I chose to share what improved in my preparation.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a rehearsal clip received a warm response, I chose to attack every critic by name.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: A Small Stage Again
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A local venue invites you to perform in an intimate setting. It is less glamorous than the image your team has been promoting, but the audience cares about the music.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Treat the audience like a headline crowd
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a local venue invited me to an intimate performance, I chose to treat the audience like a headline crowd.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a local venue invited me to an intimate performance, I chose to build a stripped back set.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a local venue invited me to an intimate performance, I chose to talk honestly about my journey.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a local venue invited me to an intimate performance, I chose to complain about the venue size.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Apology Draft
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: Your publicist drafts a polished apology for a recent public disagreement. It sounds impressive, but it barely acknowledges what actually hurt people.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Rewrite it in my own words
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When I reviewed a draft apology, I chose to rewrite it in my own words.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When I reviewed a draft apology, I chose to acknowledge the specific harm.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Ask a trusted person for feedback
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When I reviewed a draft apology, I chose to ask a trusted person for feedback.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When I reviewed a draft apology, I chose to post it without reading carefully.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Old Team Member
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A former collaborator reaches out after hearing your new work. Your last project ended awkwardly, but they want to talk about what went wrong.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a former collaborator asked to talk, I chose to hear them out privately.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Acknowledge my part in the disagreement
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a former collaborator asked to talk, I chose to acknowledge my part in the disagreement.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Set clear limits for the conversation
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a former collaborator asked to talk, I chose to set clear limits for the conversation.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a former collaborator asked to talk, I chose to post their message for entertainment.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: A Healthier Schedule
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: Your team suggests packing every free day with promotional appearances. You worry that constant exhaustion will make it harder to deliver your best work.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: During a discussion about my promotional schedule, I chose to set realistic limits.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: During a discussion about my promotional schedule, I chose to choose fewer meaningful appearances.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: During a discussion about my promotional schedule, I chose to discuss support with my team.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: During a discussion about my promotional schedule, I chose to pretend I can handle everything.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The New Listener
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A young listener tells you this is the first project of yours they have heard. Your longtime fans insist they must study your whole catalogue before commenting.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When longtime fans challenged a new listener, I chose to welcome the new listener.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When longtime fans challenged a new listener, I chose to suggest an easy starting point.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When longtime fans challenged a new listener, I chose to encourage everyone to share favorites.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Agree that newcomers should stay silent
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When longtime fans challenged a new listener, I chose to agree that newcomers should stay silent.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: No More Perfect Image
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: An interviewer asks whether your comeback means you are finally a perfect role model. The question leaves little room for ordinary mistakes or growth.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Say growth is an ongoing process
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When an interviewer called me a perfect role model, I chose to say growth is an ongoing process.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Discuss the lessons I can share
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When an interviewer called me a perfect role model, I chose to discuss the lessons I can share.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Keep the answer focused on music
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When an interviewer called me a perfect role model, I chose to keep the answer focused on music.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Declare that I never make mistakes
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When an interviewer called me a perfect role model, I chose to declare that I never make mistakes.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Rain Check
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: Rain delays an outdoor performance. Some fans have traveled a long way, and your team is waiting for the venue to confirm what is safe.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Keep fans informed while awaiting clearance
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When rain delayed an outdoor performance, I chose to keep fans informed while awaiting clearance.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Thank the crew and audience for patience
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When rain delayed an outdoor performance, I chose to thank the crew and audience for patience.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When rain delayed an outdoor performance, I chose to share a lighthearted backstage message.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Pressure the crew to ignore safety concerns
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When rain delayed an outdoor performance, I chose to pressure the crew to ignore safety concerns.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Missing Monitor
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A monitor problem makes rehearsal frustrating. The crew is working on it, but a bystander starts recording your reaction.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: During a monitor problem at rehearsal, I chose to work patiently with the crew.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Ask for a practical backup plan
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: During a monitor problem at rehearsal, I chose to ask for a practical backup plan.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: During a monitor problem at rehearsal, I chose to laugh about the awkward rehearsal.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: During a monitor problem at rehearsal, I chose to yell at the nearest technician.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Deep Cut Request
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A crowd chants for an older favorite you had not planned to perform. You know the song, but your current set has a carefully rehearsed flow.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a crowd requested an older favorite, I chose to acknowledge the request warmly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a crowd requested an older favorite, I chose to try a brief spontaneous version.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Explain why it is absent tonight
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a crowd requested an older favorite, I chose to explain why it is absent tonight.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a crowd requested an older favorite, I chose to mock their taste.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Support Act
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: Your support act delivers a strong performance, and fans begin praising them online. Someone on your team suggests keeping their name off the recap.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: After my support act earned enthusiastic praise, I chose to celebrate their performance.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: After my support act earned enthusiastic praise, I chose to thank them publicly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Share the spotlight in the recap
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: After my support act earned enthusiastic praise, I chose to share the spotlight in the recap.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: After my support act earned enthusiastic praise, I chose to remove their credit.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Accessibility Request
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A fan asks whether your event announcements can include clearer accessibility information. Your team has never considered how hard it is to find those details.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Raise the request with the venue
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a fan asked for clearer accessibility information, I chose to raise the request with the venue.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a fan asked for clearer accessibility information, I chose to help the team communicate clearly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a fan asked for clearer accessibility information, I chose to thank the fan for explaining.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a fan asked for clearer accessibility information, I chose to dismiss the request as inconvenient.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Quiet Audience
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: An audience listens quietly during a personal performance. Your team worries about the energy, but several listeners appear deeply moved.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Respect the mood of the room
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When an audience listened quietly to my performance, I chose to respect the mood of the room.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When an audience listened quietly to my performance, I chose to invite a gentle singalong.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Explain why the piece matters to me
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When an audience listened quietly to my performance, I chose to explain why the piece matters to me.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Insult the crowd for being quiet
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When an audience listened quietly to my performance, I chose to insult the crowd for being quiet.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Backstage Promise
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: Someone on your team promises a fan a backstage meeting without checking with you. The fan is excited, but your schedule is already tight.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When my team made a backstage promise without checking, I chose to find a respectful solution.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Ask the team to explain honestly
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When my team made a backstage promise without checking, I chose to ask the team to explain honestly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Offer a brief greeting if possible
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When my team made a backstage promise without checking, I chose to offer a brief greeting if possible.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Blame the fan for believing it
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When my team made a backstage promise without checking, I chose to blame the fan for believing it.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: A Crew Member Gets Applause
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A technician quietly solves a difficult problem moments before your performance. The crowd has no idea who made the show possible.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: After a technician saved a difficult performance, I chose to thank the crew onstage.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: After a technician saved a difficult performance, I chose to give the technician personal credit.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Mention the team in my recap
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: After a technician saved a difficult performance, I chose to mention the team in my recap.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: After a technician saved a difficult performance, I chose to claim I solved everything myself.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Acceptance Speech Draft
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: Your team suggests an acceptance speech centered entirely on your personal brilliance. You have a short time to speak and a long list of people who helped.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When I prepared an acceptance speech, I chose to thank collaborators and supporters.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Tell a short story about the work
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When I prepared an acceptance speech, I chose to tell a short story about the work.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When I prepared an acceptance speech, I chose to encourage the next generation.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When I prepared an acceptance speech, I chose to spend the speech mocking rivals.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: A Nomination, Not a Verdict
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: Fans are upset about an award nomination you did not receive. A reporter asks whether the omission means the whole industry is against you.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a reporter questioned an award omission, I chose to celebrate the nominated artists.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Focus on the listeners who connect with my work
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a reporter questioned an award omission, I chose to focus on the listeners who connect with my work.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a reporter questioned an award omission, I chose to admit disappointment without attacking anyone.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a reporter questioned an award omission, I chose to call every nominee undeserving.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Presenter Mispronounces It
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: At a public ceremony, a presenter mispronounces your name. They look embarrassed when they notice the mistake.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a presenter mispronounced my name, I chose to correct it kindly.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a presenter mispronounced my name, I chose to make a friendly joke.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a presenter mispronounced my name, I chose to move on without a scene.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a presenter mispronounced my name, I chose to humiliate the presenter.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Tribute Request
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: Organizers invite you to participate in a tribute to a respected musician. They ask whether you want to perform faithfully or reinterpret the work.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When organizers invited me to a musician tribute, I chose to honor the original spirit.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When organizers invited me to a musician tribute, I chose to explain a thoughtful reinterpretation.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When organizers invited me to a musician tribute, I chose to share a personal memory.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Make the whole segment about myself
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When organizers invited me to a musician tribute, I chose to make the whole segment about myself.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Camera Finds You
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: During another artist acceptance speech, a camera turns toward you. A fan account is already waiting to interpret every expression.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a camera found me during another artist speech, I chose to applaud their achievement.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a camera found me during another artist speech, I chose to smile and listen attentively.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a camera found me during another artist speech, I chose to keep a neutral expression.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a camera found me during another artist speech, I chose to make an obvious dismissive gesture.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: A Shared Honor
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: An event organizer introduces your work as a solo achievement even though a collaborator helped shape its most celebrated moments.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 1: Invite the collaborator into the moment
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When an organizer overlooked a collaborator contribution, I chose to invite the collaborator into the moment.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When an organizer overlooked a collaborator contribution, I chose to explain the shared creative process.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When an organizer overlooked a collaborator contribution, I chose to thank them in my remarks.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When an organizer overlooked a collaborator contribution, I chose to let the misleading introduction stand.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Red Carpet Question
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: On a red carpet, a reporter asks you to rank everyone else music from best to worst. You would rather discuss your own creative work.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a red carpet reporter asked me to rank other artists, I chose to discuss the work I admire.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a red carpet reporter asked me to rank other artists, I chose to set a friendly boundary.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 3: Turn the question into a playful nonanswer
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a red carpet reporter asked me to rank other artists, I chose to turn the question into a playful nonanswer.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a red carpet reporter asked me to rank other artists, I chose to give a cruel ranking.

a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Title: The Next Generation
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Body: A beginner tells you that seeing your career recognized made their dream feel possible. A nearby reporter asks what advice you would give them.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 1: When a beginner asked for advice at a public event, I chose to encourage practice and patience.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 2: Explain that every path looks different
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 2: When a beginner asked for advice at a public event, I chose to explain that every path looks different.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 3: When a beginner asked for advice at a public event, I chose to share one honest lesson.
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Choice 4: Promise instant fame if they copy me
a16_dumb-scenarios-music-enc.Narrative 4: When a beginner asked for advice at a public event, I chose to promise instant fame if they copy me.

a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Title: The Honest Credits
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Body: A session player notices their contribution is absent from the working credits. <artist> wants the release announcement out today.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 1: During a studio decision about the honest credits, I chose to correct the credits.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 2: During a studio decision about the honest credits, I chose to discuss the omission privately.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 3: During a studio decision about the honest credits, I chose to promise a later correction.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 4: During a studio decision about the honest credits, I chose to ignore the contribution.

a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Title: One More Take
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Body: <artist> wants another take even though the current recording is strong. You suspect fatigue is making every detail feel like a disaster.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 1: During a studio decision about one more take, I chose to take a listening break.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 2: During a studio decision about one more take, I chose to compare the takes calmly.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 3: During a studio decision about one more take, I chose to record a short alternative.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 4: During a studio decision about one more take, I chose to mock the concern.

a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Title: The Reference Track
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Body: Your team brings a reference that sounds so close to another artist that the session is drifting toward imitation.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Choice 1: Discuss what makes the reference work
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 1: During a studio decision about the reference track, I chose to discuss what makes the reference work.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 2: During a studio decision about the reference track, I chose to develop a distinct arrangement.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 3: During a studio decision about the reference track, I chose to ask for different references.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 4: During a studio decision about the reference track, I chose to copy every detail.

a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Title: The Empty Credit
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Body: Someone who did not participate in a session asks for a prominent production credit because they introduced you to <artist>.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 1: During a studio decision about the empty credit, I chose to keep the credits accurate.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 2: During a studio decision about the empty credit, I chose to thank them separately.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 3: During a studio decision about the empty credit, I chose to discuss an honest acknowledgment.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Choice 4: Give them a false production credit
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 4: During a studio decision about the empty credit, I chose to give them a false production credit.

a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Title: Room for a New Voice
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Body: A new engineer offers a useful idea but senior staff keep interrupting. <artist> is waiting to hear the options.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Choice 1: Give the engineer time to explain
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 1: During a studio decision about room for a new voice, I chose to give the engineer time to explain.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 2: During a studio decision about room for a new voice, I chose to test the idea fairly.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 3: During a studio decision about room for a new voice, I chose to discuss it after the session.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 4: During a studio decision about room for a new voice, I chose to join the dismissive jokes.

a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Title: The Rush Mix
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Body: A deadline is approaching and <artist> hears a small but distracting problem. Fixing it needs focused work, not a public argument.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 1: During a studio decision about the rush mix, I chose to check the issue carefully.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 2: During a studio decision about the rush mix, I chose to discuss a realistic revision.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 3: During a studio decision about the rush mix, I chose to explain the tradeoff honestly.
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Narrative 4: During a studio decision about the rush mix, I chose to pretend the issue is imaginary.

a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Title: A Private Demo
a16_music-producer-dumb-scenario-enc.Body: A team member proposes sharing an intimate unfinished demo to build buzz. <artist> has not approved sharing it.
